content.text: {"explanations":[{"signal_id":"23bcf2af-67cb-4380-b33c-c5297c567b64","explanation":"Revenue against plan stands at {{fact:d3c0308e-5362-4a2d-add5-7f48ba7438ce}}, below the covenant level of {{fact:2b1e9f12-88af-480c-8839-8321fdd53587}}, so headroom is negative at {{fact:143008c9-152b-4303-8b94-f0ec44e56200}}. The test is not merely tight but already on the wrong side of the threshold. The revenue shortfall and trend signals describe the same problem."},{"signal_id":"b9f9d129-b93c-4aa8-921d-6efbd5e56b83","explanation":"Revenue came in at only {{fact:7c03c73e-aea4-4930-a6c3-32d6151c4c01}} of plan, a substantial miss for a subscription business that usually plans revenue with some visibility. This shortfall is what drives the failed revenue covenant and may also explain the steady erosion in cash headroom."},{"signal_id":"a3a49482-7e1d-497f-9dad-a8981ab28887","explanation":"Headroom on the revenue covenant has worsened each month, from {{fact:bd640ec7-ecf0-43d3-a63d-9192b211663f}} in August to {{fact:a542ff08-ffd1-4346-a466-7861b003c49b}} in September and {{fact:143008c9-152b-4303-8b94-f0ec44e56200}} in October. The miss is deepening rather than a one-off, which makes the current shortfall harder to dismiss as timing."},{"signal_id":"3d8f28d2-c69f-4f5c-94c7-82fe888e6c28","explanation":"Unrestricted cash of {{fact:dbd79489-2b03-4727-a834-ad64cbe6d2f4}} is still well above the {{fact:470a0286-54f6-4cc7-9317-4263d93d03ed}} minimum, but headroom has slid from {{fact:fdb0de1b-4a3b-4926-a56f-074e66e78c2b}} in August to {{fact:646000c5-6cea-46af-87a0-9d19e4f548b5}} in October. Falling cash alongside a widening revenue miss may point to burn that the business is not covering with sales."}],"ranking":["23bcf2af-67cb-4380-b33c-c5297c567b64","b9f9d129-b93c-4aa8-921d-6efbd5e56b83","a3a49482-7e1d-497f-9dad-a8981ab28887","3d8f28d2-c69f-4f5c-94c7-82fe888e6c28"]}
